checks: Twice per debug/release; identical normalized identities. Compiled per-source mutation and exact restoration; strict Clippy; narrow rustfmt; repeated syntax.
cost: Finite exhaustive enumeration; exponential in fixture word length, with explicit caps in source. BWT oracle materializes n rotations; wildcard recursive oracle enumerates star partitions. No production cost or broad performance claim follows.
forward: Execute finite oracle, boundary, fiber and conditional-law assertions. Success reports agreement only on their enumerated observations.
Fixtures and expected results are deterministic. Independent reference construction avoids reusing the production state transition being tested.
inverse: Within finite tested observations, exclude suite acceptance if any expected value disagrees with its independently specified oracle or asserted conditional law. Unvisited cases are not excluded by finite testing.

The preimage of a passing test report includes every implementation agreeing on the observed fixtures, even implementations differing outside this domain. Failing reports identify a violated assertion, not a unique faulty program.

limitations: Partial syntax excludes macro expansion and semantic resolution. Finite enumeration is not a general proof; allocation exhaustion and throughput are untested. No executable approximation profile or downstream inference claim.
